# GreatSchools

> GreatSchools is a comprehensive school ratings, reviews, and comparison platform serving millions of families searching for public and private schools across the U.S.

GreatSchools provides school ratings, parent reviews, and detailed school information to help families make informed education decisions. The platform also offers B2B solutions including K-12 data licensing, the NearbySchools API, and advertising services for schools and education technology companies.

## Key Topics

- School Ratings
- School Reviews
- School Comparison
- K-12 Data
- NearbySchools API
- Public Schools
- Private Schools
- School Search
- School Directory
- Parenting Resources
- Real Estate Integration
- School Accounts
- B2B Solutions
- Data Licensing
- School Visibility

## Core School Discovery

- [School Ratings & Reviews for Public & Private Schools](https://www.greatschools.org): GreatSchools homepage with school ratings, reviews, and comparison tools for all school types
- [Review a School](https://www.greatschools.org/reviews): Submit and view parent reviews for schools to help families find the right fit
- [Parenting Articles, Worksheets, & Resources](https://www.greatschools.org/gk): Parenting guides, worksheets, and resources for school selection and child development

## B2B Solutions & APIs

- [GreatSchools Business Solutions](https://solutions.greatschools.org): B2B solutions including K-12 data licensing, NearbySchools API, and advertising platform
- [NearbySchools API](https://solutions.greatschools.org/k12-data-solutions/nearbyschools-api): NearbySchools API for accessing 150,000+ school data for real estate and ed-tech applications
- [K-12 Data Licensing](https://solutions.greatschools.org/k12-data-solutions/enterprise-data-license): Enterprise K-12 school data licensing with ratings, demographics, and reviews

## School & District Management

- [Claim Your School or District Profile](https://www.greatschools.org/school-accounts): Tool for schools and districts to claim and manage their GreatSchools profile
- [School Dashboard](https://www.greatschools.org/school-accounts/dashboard): Dashboard for schools to manage their GreatSchools profile and account
- [Marketing Solutions for Schools](https://solutions.greatschools.org/marketing-for-schools): Marketing solutions for schools to increase visibility and reach parents

## Advertising & Business

- [Advertise on GreatSchools](https://solutions.greatschools.org/advertising): Advertising platform to reach millions of families searching for schools
- [Media Room](https://blog.greatschools.org): Press releases, media coverage, and education news from GreatSchools

## User Account & Support

- [User Account Management](https://www.greatschools.org/account): User account management page for GreatSchools profile and saved schools

## Legal & Compliance

- [Privacy Policy](https://www.greatschools.org/gk/privacy): Privacy policy for GreatSchools website and data collection practices
- [Terms of Use](https://www.greatschools.org/gk/terms): Terms of use and legal conditions for GreatSchools website and services
